scope: CLI candidate only; separately owned website is not evaluated here
stop_rule: Challenge timebox or 20 check invocations, whichever occurs first

codex.access: existing ChatGPT authentication through existing loopback proxy
codex.smoke: passed exact file read/write and supervised completion; model identity unavailable in worker runtime report

sonnet.model_evidence: worker-reported runtime environment metadata, not independent provider attestation
sonnet.smoke: passed exact file read/write and supervised completion

haiku.model_evidence: worker-reported runtime environment metadata, not independent provider attestation
haiku.smoke: passed exact file read/write and supervised completion

tier_limits: Haiku is the smaller-model comparison hypothesis. No capability ranking or backend identity is inferred from marketing labels. Local Ollama learner tooling is not evaluated in this cohort.
coverage_limits: Seven Python and three TypeScript attempts. Four challenges receive cross-configuration comparisons; pagination and release ordering receive one attempt each. Too small and unbalanced for comparative performance claims.
access_boundary: Fresh session workspaces outside the implementation checkout; provided material contains public ticket, workflow instructions and editable files/visible checks only. Prompt restrictions are not a filesystem security sandbox. Original/reference materials remain outside the provided material but are not adversarially inaccessible on the local machine.
acceptance_limits: Synthetic learners do not establish independent-human usability, authoring acceptance or coaching usefulness. No purchases, deployments, releases or package publication are authorized by this registration.
